thread:
Jun Park: quick follow-up to RFC-239 about inter-region state handoff — a few open questions after pairing with ops this morning. primarily: do we prefer short-lease windows + client hint vs. explicit lease transfer handshake?
Priya N: +1 to call these out. short leases mean more churn but simpler operator model. what's our SLO target for lease failover?
Jun Park: target is <=200ms p95 for local writes, but degraded to 2s during global handoff is acceptable if we avoid split-write.
Alex W: short leases + client hints seems nicer for mobile-first clients (less extra roundtrips). but for enterprise tenants with residency constraints, explicit transfer gives stronger audit trail.
Samir R: experiment idea — try 2s lease TTL with randomized 200-400ms jitter and client-provided "X-Region-Prefer" header for 2 weeks in canary. measure cross-region write tail and conflict rate.
Maria G: sounds reasonable. we should also emit an event when we detect a lease contention so billing/ops can correlate. add metric: lease_handoff_conflicts_count.
Priya N: ops concern: if we rely on client hint, what about misbehaving SDKs? need server-side fallback to transfer. maybe prefer hint-first, then transfer-on-failure.
Jun Park: agreed. fallback path: on write attempt if hint mismatch or resident check fails, return 409 with a transient handoff token. client retries with token -> server performs lease transfer and retries write. keep retries bounded.
Alex W: sketch of error flow:
```
HTTP 409 {
  "error": "region-mismatch",
  "handoff_token": "abc123",
  "retry_after": 1.2
}
client -> POST with X-Handoff-Token -> server performs transfer -> 200
```
Samir R: implementable. still worried about pathological churn on global outages. need operator circuit-breaker to stop transfers for tenant if transfer_rate > X/min.
Maria G: +1 on circuit-breaker. Add a soft quarantine state for tenants where we suspend transfers and route to read-only until manual review.
Priya N: runbook note: when tenant enters quarantine, notify #customer-success and flag in console. include TTL to auto-clear after 72h if no operator action.
Jun Park: action items: 1) Samir prototype TTL+jitter + metric emission (owner: Samir) 2) Alex add 409/handoff_token API contract to RFC-239 (owner: Alex) 3) Priya add runbook and console flagging (owner: Priya) 4) Maria add circuit-breaker metric/alert (owner: Maria). Can we get these done this sprint?
Samir R: I can spike and have prototype by EOW.
Alex W: I'll update the RFC and include sequence diagrams.
Priya N: I'll draft runbook today and ping SRE for review.
Maria G: will add alert thresholds and a Grafana panel for handoffs.
infra-bot: reminder: please add Jira tasks with labels infra/lease-handoff, rfc-239, and tag oncall for the first rollout.
Jun Park: thanks all. leaving this thread open for any late edge-cases. tagging @Alex and @Samir to keep sync. :+1:
